Ruth is an ancestor of **Jack** (Ruth → Rebecca → Noah → Henry → Diane → Martha → … → Matthew → Jack).

Gerald is also an ancestor of **Jack** (Gerald → Gary → Jonathan → Carol → Arthur → … → Theresa → Evelyn → Debra → Janet → … → Mark → Justin → Jack).

So Ruth and Gerald **share a common descendant** (Jack).
